title: RoboPulse Learned Progress Factor Tensor v1
summary: Source-held-out multi-view before/after progress representation with conformal UNKNOWN; SC45 produced a real but sub-gate gain.

mechanisms.name: Learned Progress Factor Tensor
mechanisms.description: Projects front and wrist before/after CLIP changes against visual and task completion axes, groups them as effect, actuator, spatial, conflict, and handoff factors, learns a fixed linear probability model, and delegates final authority to a split-conformal set reducer.
inputs: Task start/end references, before/after front and wrist images, task text, disjoint training/calibration labels.
outputs: Progress, regression, or UNKNOWN plus factor tensor and calibrated probabilities.
mechanisms.limitations: SC45 missed its frozen gain gate; global features transferred unevenly to human-hand video, do not retune the consumed split, and do not infer arrival or completion authority.
